earnings.title: SoFi Reports Third Quarter 2026 with Record Net Revenue of $1.4 Billion, Net Income of $241 Million and Raises Full-Year Guidance
highlights: Adjusted Net income of $243 million, with $0.18 EPS
Earnings per share attributable to common stockholders – diluted $ 0.18 $ 0.11 64 % $ 0.41 $ 0.25 64 %
Adjusted Net Revenue up 44% to a record $1.4 billion

quotes.text: We had exceptional Q3 results against the backdrop of any environment, but they are even more remarkable given how 2026 has unfolded.

outlook: Raised 2026 guidance to $5.04 billion adjusted net revenue, $1.66 billion adjusted EBITDA
Introduced 2027 outlook of $6.4 billion adjusted net revenue, $2.24 billion adjusted EBITDA, $0.90 of EPS
SoFi now expects $5.04 billion of adjusted net revenue which is a year-over-year increase of 40%, $1.66 billion of adjusted EBITDA, $840.0 million of net income and $0.61 of EPS.

items.heading: We operate in rapidly evolving industries and have limited experience in parts of our Financial Services and Technology Platform segments, which may make it difficult for us to successfully identify and address the risks and uncertainties we face.
We have a history of losses and may experience net losses in the future and there is no assurance that our revenue and business model will be successful.

We have experienced rapid growth in recent years, including through the addition of new products and lines of business and entry into new geographies, which may place significant demands on our operational, risk management, sales and marketing, technology, compliance, and finance and accounting resources.

items.heading: Our results of operations and future prospects depend on our ability to retain existing members and attract new members. We face intense and increasing competition and, if we do not compete effectively, our competitive positioning and our operating results will be harmed.
